author: Daron Letts
title: Cabinet to discuss Kitikmeot Inuit employment pilot project
content:
Nunavut’s cabinet ministers will discuss a proposed pilot project that would see only Inuit hired for territorial government positions in the Kitikmeot Region.


Human Resources Minister Annie Tattuinee says she will bring a proposal for a Kitikmeot-based Inuit hiring pilot project to cabinet. (Photo by Daron Letts)


Cambridge Bay MLA Fred Pedersen pitched the idea in the legislative assembly Monday.


“We can take it into consideration,” said Human Resources Minister Annie Tattuinee.


Pedersen’s proposal would see non-Inuit employees offered similar positions in

other regions. Only Inuit would be allowed to replace them.


This practice would apply to positions that become open as non-Inuit staff retire.

Pedersen suggested the pilot project could run for five years, but its length would be up to cabinet.


“I look forward to hearing what cabinet’s thoughts are on it,” he said during an interview.


The current Inuit employment rate in the Kitikmeot is 57 per cent, slightly above the territorial average of approximately 50 per cent.


According to Article 23 of the Nunavut agreement, the government is obligated to pursue an 85-per-cent Inuit workforce. Eligible Inuit are defined as those enrolled as beneficiaries under Article 35 of the agreement.


“It is evident that this government has had issues meeting a Nunavut Inuit hiring target of around 85 per cent,” Pedersen said.


He suggested that the government consider broadening the definition of Inuit to include other Inuit land claim groups from beyond Nunavut — such as Inuit from Inuvialuit, Nunavik, Nunatsiavut or urban Inuit from the south — many of whom are related to Nunavut Inuit.


Pedersen acknowledged the change would be difficult, given the clear definition outlined in the Nunavut Agreement.


“It’s fairly hard to change,” he said.


However, he pointed to an approach adopted by the Northwest Territories, which enacted the Indigenous Employment Policy in April.


That policy offers preferred hiring status for Indigenous peoples, with primary consideration given to recognized members or descendants of First Nations, Métis or Inuit who are indigenous to the present boundaries of the Northwest Territories.


When the policy went into effect, Indigenous employees made up about 30 per cent of the NWT government’s workforce, while Indigenous residents made up close to half of the NWT population.


“I’ve heard anecdotally that their Indigenous numbers have increased since they changed the policy,” Pedersen said.


While Tattuinee agreed to discuss Pedersen’s regional hiring pilot strategy, she stopped short of agreeing to consider broadening the definition of Inuit beyond that outlined in the Nunavut Agreement.


“Our priority is Inuit enrolled under Article 35,” she said.

author: Emma Honeybun
title: Former junior hockey commentator charged with child sexploitation, RCMP looking for more victims
content:
A long-time junior sports commentator who worked in Alberta and British Columbia has been arrested and charged with sexually exploiting three teenage boys, and the RCMP are looking for additional victims.

“This is a big news story, but our goal is to help any victims that haven’t come forward,” said RCMP Corporal Gina Slaney. “Be strong, we will help you all along the way, we’re there for you … please.”

In an online media conference Monday afternoon, the RCMP’s Southern Alberta general investigation section [GIS] announced that 39-year-old Tyler King had been charged with three counts of luring an individual under 18, sexual exploitation of a young person, and creation of child pornography.

The investigation has been ongoing since June 2024, when an employee from the Okotoks Oilers Athletic Association, based out of Okotoks, Alta., had reported King to local law enforcement.

He had allegedly approached three hockey players, minors at the time, and exchanged favours for sexual acts, according to the RCMP.

Although these charges would have happened in or around Okotoks in between 2021 and 2024, King had previously been involved with junior teams in Fort McMurray and Brooks, where he took on business and communication roles.

An undetermined number of the three victims hailed from Saskatchewan, although the RCMP did not disclose where.

King stopped working with the Okotoks Oilers on June 21, 2024, around when RCMP received word of the allegations.

Following this, he moved to Nanaimo, B.C., and picked up a job with the Nanaimo Clippers. The RCMP stated that the team was “likely not aware of this report when they hired him.”

Finally, he moved across the border to New York State, where he worked at SUNY Oswego University until he was arrested in Ontario on Oct. 31, after crossing the border.

Investigators said there’s “a very likely possibility” of more victims in each of the areas King worked, and that they are encouraged to approach local police.

As of Monday, King remains in Ontario but is scheduled to return to Alberta “sometime this week,” officers said, where the allegations will eventually be tested in court.

The RCMP is also working with partners in New York to investigate the potentiality of victims in the states.

Emma is a Red River Métis with family roots in St. Malo, Manitoba. She graduated from RRC Polytech’s Creative Communications program in 2023 and went on to serve as a community journalist and photographer for the Free Press Community Review until she joined APTN in 2026. Equipped with a strong sense of justice, she enjoys covering stories in the central prairies for a larger audience. Her work has also appeared in Manitoba Inc. Magazine, the Free Press, and RRC Polytech’s student paper, The Projector.

author: Unknown
title: Students in Kobanê reject incorporation of their university
content:
Students and staff at the University of Kobanê have rejected plans to incorporate their institution into the University of Aleppo. In a statement marking World Kobanê Day on November 1, they called for the university’s institutional autonomy to be preserved and for no decisions about its future to be made without the participation of its students and staff. They explicitly stated that they were not opposed to cooperation with other Syrian universities.


The statement was read out by student Gulistan Elî in front of the university building in Kobanê, in the presence of faculty members and students. It came in response to a recent decision by the Syrian Ministry of Higher Education to integrate the University of Kobanê into the state higher education system.


Opposition despite agreement with Damascus


Just on Saturday, the university administration announced the outcome of further negotiations with the Syrian government. According to the agreement, the University of Kobanê is to be incorporated into the University of Aleppo as a group of faculties while retaining its own administrative structures. Students already enrolled will be allowed to complete their studies under the existing system. Recognition of their degrees has also been guaranteed.


For the signatories of the new statement, however, these assurances are insufficient. They oppose any arrangement that could result in their university losing its current name, academic structure, or administrative autonomy.


“We will under no circumstances accept a decision that seeks to incorporate the University of Kobanê into the University of Aleppo under the designation of an academic consortium, or to change its name, administrative structure, or academic organization. Such decisions must be based on the consent of students and take into account the university’s distinctive characteristics,” the statement said.


“Not just an educational institution”


University students and staff justify their opposition by emphasizing the institution’s particular significance for the Kurdish population. They describe the university as a product of the social development process in Rojava and a symbol of the opportunity to pursue higher education while preserving their own language and cultural identity.


“The University of Kobanê is not merely an educational institution whose name can be changed by an administrative decision or which can be merged with another university. It is an academic institution of scientific, cultural, and linguistic significance.”


The students stressed that their opposition is directed neither against the University of Aleppo nor against other Syrian educational institutions. Academic cooperation could be beneficial, they say, but it must not come at the expense of their university’s institutional identity.


Participation instead of unilateral decisions


The key demands include autonomy in academic decision-making, the protection of linguistic and cultural characteristics, and the guaranteed participation of students, faculty members, and administrative staff in all negotiations concerning the university’s future.


“Any change affecting the university’s name, system, or academic foundations is entirely unacceptable without genuine dialogue with students and staff. Dialogue and mutual understanding must form the basis of any future cooperation,” the university community stated.


The signatories also warned against making the future of educational institutions dependent on political developments rather than scientific and academic criteria.


“The Universities of Kobanê and Rojava are more than just names. They embody an academic identity, a distinct cultural character, and a right to education that deserves respect and protection.”


The students have announced that they will continue to resist fundamental changes imposed on their university without their consent.

author: Unknown
title: Geothermal project in Varto: Court examines potential environmental damage
content:
A court-ordered site inspection has taken place as part of a legal dispute over a planned geothermal project on the border between the Kurdish provinces of Bingöl and Muş. A panel of experts appointed by the Bingöl Administrative Court examined the proposed drilling sites in the villages of Licik, Çermî, and Şorik in the Karlıova district. Local residents fear that the project will severely threaten their livelihoods and are demanding its cancellation.


The project, undertaken by the US-based company IGNIS H2 Energy, covers an area between Karlıova and Varto. Affected residents filed a lawsuit against the project in April. In July, the court ordered an expert assessment and an on-site inspection.


Concerns over water sources and agriculture


Numerous local residents participated in the inspection on Monday. The expert panel was accompanied by DEM Party MPs Ibrahim Akın and Sümeyye Boz, lawyers from the Diyarbakır Bar Association, and representatives of various environmental organizations from Kurdistan and Turkey.


Akın, who also serves as co-spokesperson for the DEM Party’s Ecology Commission, highlighted the local population’s ongoing resistance. He stated that the inspections would extend from Bingöl to the Varto region.


“We hope that the expert report will help protect the existing livelihoods of our people. Regardless of the report’s findings, we will stand alongside those resisting the project,” Akın said.


DEM Party MP Sümeyye Boz emphasized that the planned activities would not be limited to individual drilling sites. Rather, she said, the project would affect an extensive area encompassing numerous villages, agricultural lands, and pastures.


“This is a project stretching from Karlıova to Varto that threatens to destroy a vast area where people live and work. That is why people in both regions have been resisting it for months,” Boz said.


“Courts must decide in favor of people’s lives”


Boz stressed that the site inspection must determine, in particular, the potential impact of the planned drilling operations on settlements, water resources, agriculture, and livestock farming. She expressed hope that the expert panel would take the potential consequences into account through its direct observations on the ground.


“We hope that the courts will rule in favor of people’s lives rather than the interests of companies. We will continue our struggle,” the MP stated.


Following the completion of the inspections in Karlıova and Varto, the expert report will serve as a basis for further judicial review of the controversial geothermal project.

author: Unknown
title: 29 women killed in Southern Kurdistan in ten months
content:
In the first ten months of 2026, at least 29 women were victims of femicide in Southern Kurdistan. Another 29 women died under suspicious circumstances, according to a recent analysis by the Roj News agency. Three women were killed in October alone.


On October 15, a 20-year-old woman was killed by her brother, who was eight years older than her, in the Domîz subdistrict of Sêmêlê district near Duhok. Five days later, on October 20, 30-year-old Kîjan Burhan was murdered by her father, who shot her three times, in Sulaymaniyah.


The third case was reported on October 29 in the village of Şêx Turab near Hewlêr (Erbil), where the body of a murdered woman was discovered. Four suspects were arrested, and police in Hewlêr launched an investigation.


Women’s organizations have long criticized domestic violence as one of the most serious social problems in Southern Kurdistan. They are calling for effective prevention and intervention measures aimed at preventing violence, protecting victims, and bringing about lasting changes in violent patterns of behavior.

author: Valerie Anne
title: ‘Criminal Minds’ Has Unceremoniously Been Canceled
content:
In devastating news for me specifically, it was announced that the upcoming 20th season of Criminal Minds will be its last. What’s worse is that they had already finished filming the series by the time this news broke, and this abrupt cancellation means we won’t even get a proper series finale, even though there will have been over 370 episodes by the time the new season finishes airing. It feels like a slap in the face this show doesn’t deserve!

Now, there’s always the chance another network saves them from oblivion; it’s happened once before. The first 15 seasons of the show aired on CBS from 2005-2020, but then two years later it was revived as Criminal Minds: Evolution on Paramount+ without much structural change. We still had most of the same characters, only now they could say “fuck”, which they did with much aplomb. It is also in this Evolution series that Nicole Pacent joined the show as Rebecca Wilson, who became a love interest for long-standing member of the BAU family Tara Lewis, played by Aisha Tyler.

The shortening from 22 episodes to 10 was a hard one to bear, but I was grateful for anything after that two-year dark period. The bonus gayness didn’t hurt. Unfortunately, this did lead to some disappointing side effects, like the fact that Tara and Rebecca got married entirely off-screen between seasons. Back in my day, there would have been a whole lesbian wedding Very Special Episode. But alas. They were still together and still had some scenes together, and that’s what mattered!

The show also had some behind-the-scenes queerness, with Nicole Pacent and Aisha Tyler being queer in real life (at least, I think Aisha Tyler is queer…she has said vague things like “I like everybody” and “I think everyone is a little bit gay” so I’m going with yes for now), and also Kirsten Vangsness who has played Garcia throughout the entire run of the show is queer as well.

Of course, I can’t talk about Criminal Minds queerness without also talking about the crack ship that has been taunting us for decades now: JJ and Emily, or, lovingly, “Jemily.” Long before we had any canon queerness on the show (for which we are very grateful!!) we had JJ and Emily and their “history will call them best friends” relationship. Every once in a while since the creators caught wind, they would throw us a crumb, like the time they got high together. I might miss them most of all. At least we’ll always have fanfic.

I’m especially sad because it seemed like we were maybe finally moving past the Sicarius storyline that had played itself out, and maybe even contributed to its cancellation. I think this show could still have many more seasons left in it, if someone new would give them a chance. Shonda? You busy?

Until then, we have one last season to enjoy and savor before we have to say goodbye to our beloved BAU once again.

title: “Vatandaşın hakkı olan 615 milyon doları BYD’den tahsil edin”
content:
Yeni Parti Zonguldak Milletvekili Deniz Yavuzyılmaz, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, BYD’ye sağlanan yatırım teşviklerini ve vergi muafiyetlerini gündeme taşıdı.

BYD’ye sağlanan vergi muafiyetleri nedeniyle kamunun 615 milyon doların üzerinde kayba uğradığını iddia eden Yavuzyılmaz, “AKP’nin, Çinli otomotiv devi BYD’ye 615 milyon dolar vergi kıyağı yaptığını tespit ettik! Peki nasıl? 5 Temmuz 2024’te; Ticaret Bakanlığı, BYD’ye yapacağı kıyaklara giden yolun taşlarını döşemeye başlıyor. Yatırım teşvik belgesi kapsamında yapılan ithalatı ek gümrük vergilerinden muaf tutuyor. Üç gün sonra 8 Temmuz 2024’te; BYD ile Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı arasında, 1 milyar dolarlık yatırım taahhüdü üzerinden bir ‘yatırım anlaşması’ imzalanıyor. Ancak süreç boyunca: BYD ile imzalanan yatırım anlaşmasının detayları kamuoyundan gizleniyor” dedi.

BYD’ye verilen teşvik belgesinin sır gibi saklandığını söyleyen Yavuzyılmaz, “10 Haziran 2026’da; BYD, Türkiye’de yapmayı taahhüt ettiği Manisa yatırımı için takvim bulunmadığını ve projeyi askıya aldığını açıklıyor. Peki BYD, yatırım anlaşmanın imzalandığı Temmuz 2024’ten, yatırımı askıya aldığı Haziran 2026’ya kadar ne yaptı? İmtiyazlı şekilde, devasa vergi indirimi avantajlarıyla Türkiye’de tam 59.168 adet araç sattı. AKP eliyle, otomotiv sektöründeki adil rekabet ortamı paramparça edildi. Sonuç: Vergi kaybı tutarı 615 milyon dolar! Güncel kurla yaklaşık 30 milyar lira! Nasıl hesapladım? Ticaret Bakanlığı’nın BYD’ye sağladığı vergisiz ithalat hakkı kapsamında; Araç başı gümrük öncesi fiyat ortalama 11.500 dolar alındığında; Gümrük vergisi, ek vergi muafiyeti ve bu muafiyetlerin ÖTV ile KDV matrahlarına zincirleme etkisi hesaplandığında toplam vergi kaybı 615 milyon doları aşıyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanı Mehmet Fatih Kacır’a çağrıda bulunan Yavuzyılmaz, “Ya BYD’nin taahhüt ettiği fabrikayı derhal kurdurun ya da teşvik belgesini iptal edip sağlanan tüm destekleri derhal geri alın. Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat’a: Çin menşeili araç vergilerinden BYD’yi muaf tutan düzenlemeleri hemen yürürlükten kaldırın. Zamanaşımı süresi dolmadan, devletin ve vatandaşın hakkı olan 615 milyon doları faiziyle birlikte BYD’den tahsil edin” dedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Jake Johnson
title: Mamdani Threatens Trump Admin With Legal Action Over ICE’s Use of Parking Lots
content:
Agents’ use of city parking lots to stage raids amounted to “unlawful commandeering” of public property, he asserted.

Agents’ use of city parking lots to stage raids amounted to “unlawful commandeering” of public property, he asserted.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Monday threatened the Trump administration with legal action over federal immigration agents’ use of city parking lots to stage raids, which the Democratic elected official said amounted to “unlawful commandeering” of public property.

“This use of city property in furtherance of federal immigration enforcement is unauthorized and is therefore illegal, endangers city residents, and sows fear among those who seek to access city property,” Mamdani wrote in a letter addressed to U.S. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin and Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s (ICE) acting director, David Venturella.

Mamdani’s letter notes that ICE agents have “reportedly parked their vehicles and conducted meetings in several city-owned, unstaffed parking lots” — including ones near a park and a city-run preschool.

“ICE has not secured any authorization from the city to use these lots for immigration enforcement. To be clear: the city does not authorize ICE using its property in this manner,” Mamdani wrote. “Parking lots connected to city parks are reserved for the safe use and enjoyment of New Yorkers and visitors who wish to use our parks. Use of these lots for other purposes, including ICE’s reported use of these lots, amounts to unauthorized activity on City property. Accordingly, you must immediately issue guidance to your agents prohibiting them from using any City lots to stage or conduct enforcement operations.”

Mamdani’s letter comes weeks after a plainclothes ICE agent shot a Dominican immigrant in the Bronx while his 5-year-old son was in the car, infuriating community members and intensifying pressure on the mayor to do everything in his power to remove the rogue agency from New York City.

“We know that ICE is rotten to its core,” Mamdani said after the shooting. The mayor has called on President Donald Trump to end all ICE operations in New York City and has demanded abolition of the agency, saying it is “making a mockery of what law and order is supposed to be.”

In mid-October, Mamdani and more than 100 other elected New York officials called on private parking lot owners to bar ICE agents from using their property.

“In solidarity with immigrant New Yorkers and in our shared commitment to the city we love, we ask that you do not rent, lend, or otherwise make your property available to ICE as a staging area for its enforcement operations,” reads the October 16 letter. “Make it known to ICE that it is not authorized to use your garages and lots.”

title: VOLVAC patronu adını gizleyerek işçi arıyor
content:
Barış Salık [email protected] Murat Uysal [email protected]

İstanbul – Tuzla’daki VOLVAC Paketleme ve Gıda Makinaları Fabrikasının önünde kurulan çadırda direniş 8. gününe girdi. DİSK/Birleşik Metal-İş’e üye oldukları için işten çıkarılan 35 işçi fabrika kapısında bekliyor. Bu işçiler, üretimde çalışanların tamamı. Fabrikada üretim yok. İşçilerin anlattığına göre şirket yeni işçi aramak için ilan açtı. İlanlarda fabrikanın adresi birebir yer alıyor ama şirketin adı geçmiyor. İşçilerin aktardığına göre fabrikanın önünde ilk günden bu yana yaklaşık 100 polis bekliyor.

İşçi Yıldıray örgütlenme fikrinin nasıl olgunlaştığını şöyle anlattı: “Bir iş arkadaşımız vardı, işini de iyi yapan biriydi. Sebepsiz yere 25/2 ile işten atıldı. Biz zaten bir süredir içeride koşulların kötüleştiğini konuşuyorduk. Bir gün toplu bir şekilde cuma namazına giderken cami yolunda ‘Sendikaya üye olalım’ diye bir fikir geliştirdik. Ardından hızla örgütlenmeye başladık. İçeride birkaç kişi hariç herkes örgütlendi.”

İş Kanunu’nun 25/II maddesi, işverene “Ahlak ve iyi niyet kurallarına uymayan haller” gerekçesiyle işçiyi bildirimsiz ve tazminatsız çıkarma imkanı veriyor.

Eylül ayında örgütlenmesini tamamlayan işçiler yetki başvurusu yaptı. Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığının yetki tespit yazısı 15 Ekim’de geldi. Yıldıray, sonrasında yaşananları şöyle aktardı: “Yetkinin ardından patron Birleşik Metal-İş genel başkanıyla görüştü. Görüşme olumlu geçse de daha sonra çalıştığı avukatı değiştirdi. Hemen ardından da birimlerinde şef ve sorumlu olan, ben dahil 5 arkadaşı işten attı.” Atılan 5 işçi 26 Ekim Pazartesi sabahı fabrika kapısının önünde direnişe başladı. İçeride çalışmaya devam eden işçiler de arkadaşlarına sahip çıktı. Yıldıray şöyle anlattı: “Bu işten atmayla beraber çalışmaya devam eden arkadaşlarımız içeride eylemler yaptı. Biz kapı önüne çadır kurmuştuk, aralarda gelip bize destek oldular, sloganlar attılar. Geçtiğimiz cuma günü de içerideki 30 arkadaşımızı işten attılar. Şimdi 35 kişi burada mücadelemizi sürdürüyoruz.”

Yıldıray, işten atmalar karşısında devletin tutumunu da sorguluyor: “Burada içimizden biri bıçaklansa, bir saldırıya uğrasa polis gelmeyecek. Mesele patronun güvenliği olduğunda burada birikiyor. Bu kolluk kimi koruyor şimdi? İlk günden beri 100 polis bizim başımızı bekliyor, daha doğrusu patronun malını bekliyor. Oysa biz anayasal hakkımızı kullandık. Madde ne diyor? İşçi istediği sendikaya üye olabilir diyor. Eğer öyleyse patron bizi işten atarak suç işliyor, kanuna karşı geliyor. Ama bu kanunu koruyan kanunların da olması lazım. İşçiler işten atılırken patrona ‘Bunları niye işten atıyorsun?’ diye soracak devlet lazım.”

Anayasa’nın 51. maddesi, çalışanlara önceden izin almaksızın sendikalara üye olma hakkı tanıyor. 6356 sayılı Sendikalar ve Toplu İş Sözleşmesi Kanunu da sendika üyeliği nedeniyle işten çıkarmayı yasaklıyor. Birleşik Metal-İş İstanbul 1 No’lu Şube Başkanı Can Emrah Ülgü de geçen hafta patronlara danışmanlık yapan avukatlık bürolarına dikkat çekmişti. Ülgü’ye göre bu bürolar süreci sendikasızlaştırma üzerine kuruyor ve patronlara yol haritası sunuyor.

VOLVAC, gıda paketleme makineleri üretiyor ve ağırlıklı olarak ihracata çalışıyor. Şirket, tanıtımında ABD, Rusya, Çin ve Almanya dahil 42’den fazla ülkeye satış yaptığını söylüyor. Sendikaya göre siparişler yoğun. Ancak üretimde çalışan işçilerin tamamı atıldığı için fabrikada üretim durmuş durumda. İçeride yalnızca sekreterlik, insan kaynakları ve satış bölümlerinde çalışanlar kaldı.

İşçiler, daha bir hafta öncesine kadar siparişler yetişsin diye enselerinde boza pişiren patronun şimdi ne yaptığını merak ediyor.

Sorunun yanıtına dair bir ipucu bir iş ilanından geldi. İşçilerin anlattığına göre şirket yeni işçi arıyor. İlanda fabrikanın adresi birebir yer alıyor ama şirketin adı geçmiyor.

title: Federal Government Is Targeting Officials Who Are Trying to Hold ICE Accountable
content:
Since January, the House Judiciary Committee and Department of Justice have targeted 65 state and local officials.

Since January, the House Judiciary Committee and Department of Justice have targeted 65 state and local officials.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

In the months leading up to the 2026 midterm elections, congressional Republicans and federal prosecutors have targeted dozens of local officials in cities and counties across the country that have adopted some sanctuary policies. The investigations have increasingly focused on prosecutors and law enforcement officers, many of whom have publicly announced plans to go after Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents who commit crimes in their jurisdictions or refuse demands to cooperate with federal immigration policing.

In total, 65 officials in 16 states have been targeted since January, according to a review of documents released by the House Judiciary Committee and the Department of Justice (DOJ), as well as interviews with senior officials who have direct knowledge of individual investigations. The House Judiciary Committee has issued subpoenas and other demands for testimony, documents, and records to more than 40 officials, 15 of them local prosecutors. Alongside that, the DOJ has initiated investigations into 50 local or state officials since 2025, including five involving local prosecutors. In all, 17 local prosecutors have been swept up in House Judiciary or DOJ investigations and lawsuits related to immigration policies.

House Judiciary Committee Chair Rep. Jim Jordan said in a recent report that “Democrats’ open-borders policies at the federal level and sanctuary policies at the state and local level allow millions of illegal aliens to pour into the country and ensure that criminal aliens, after encountered by local law enforcement, are released back into American communities,” echoing language the committee has commonly used in its investigations.

Many experts describe these investigations as unprecedented, and view the move as retaliation against local officials who refuse to cooperate with federal immigration agents or threaten legal action against ICE officers.

“These [prosecutors] are being intentionally intimidated by congressional and federal authorities,” said Mona Sahaf, the director of the Reshaping Prosecution initiative at the Vera Institute of Justice. “The use of [the] DOJ to target perceived political opponents is new. It’s busting norms, and it’s highly dangerous.”

The targeting of local prosecutors appears to be a matter of policy in the second Trump administration. “Sanctuary Jurisdictions Directives” issued by the attorney general’s office on February 5, 2025, held that the DOJ Civil Rights Division should “identify state and local laws, policies, and practices that facilitate violations of federal immigration laws or impede lawful federal immigration operations,” and “where appropriate, take legal action to challenge such laws, policies, or practices.”

The DOJ, in a June 18 press release announcing an investigation into local officials in Philadelphia — including District Attorney Larry Krasner — concerning a policy prohibiting federal agents from wearing masks, said that its “series of lawsuits brought by the Civil Division” targeted “illegal policies designed to thwart federal law enforcement across the country.”

Rebecca Roiphe, the Joseph Solomon Distinguished Professor of Law at New York Law School, said the investigations into local prosecutors represented “a wholesale abandonment” of the principle of separation between the DOJ and the political branches of government. “This administration has pretty openly suggested that it is normal and appropriate and even laudable for the political branches to have some degree of control over the Department of Justice,” she said.

Referring to the DOJ investigations, Roiphe said, “The bottom line is that these federal prosecutions can end up threatening local prosecutors to fall in line with federal priorities, and that’s illegitimate in our system.”

These overlapping investigations, reports, and the DOJ directives follow the Heritage Foundation’s Project 2025 threat to “initiate legal action against” prosecutors who refuse to adhere to the priorities of the Trump administration. title: Eisenhower’ın dünya küresi Pentagon'da taşınırken nasıl kırıldı?
content:
Pentagon’un koridorlarından birinde 1930’lardan kalma, çapı 75 santimi geçen bir dünya küresi duruyor. Amerikan ordusu bu küreyi seksen yılı aşkın süredir kuşaktan kuşağa koruyor. Yaygın inanışa göre General Dwight Eisenhower, 1942’de savaş planlarını hazırlarken kürenin başında çalıştı. Yanındaki plakette bunun yalnızca popüler teori olduğu yazıyorsa da efsane plaketten daha güçlü görünüyor.

Bu yılın başında Amerikan Fox News kanalının eski sabah programı sunucusu, bugünün Savunma Bakanı Pete Hegseth küreyi makam odasında görmek istedi. Böyle eserleri normalde ordunun askeri tarih uzmanları taşıyor. Ancak o günlerde hükümet kapanmıştı ve uzmanlar zorunlu izindeydi. Bakanın ekibi beklemedi. Şubat ayında küreyi kendileri kaldırmaya çalıştılar ve düşürdüler. Küre, oyma ahşap ayağının içindeki metal eksenden koptu ve alt tarafında, tam Antarktika’nın üzerinde yarık açıldı.

Olay aylarca gizli kaldı. Washington Post, ekim ayında fotoğraflarla ortaya çıkarınca Pentagon önce kazaların olabileceğini, kimsenin yaralanmadığını ve kürenin tamir edildiğini söyledi. Ardından düşenin replika olduğunu öne sürdü. NBC News ise üç yetkilinin anlatımına ve fotoğrafa dayanarak kırılanın orijinal küre olduğunu doğruladı. Düşürenler için orijinal ya da replika fark etmeyebilir, sonuçta boya ve alçıydı. Oysa bazı eşyalar döneminin bütün hafızasını taşırlar.

Eisenhower o küreyi döndürdüğünde dünya savaştaydı. Washington’da savaş planlarının başındaydı. İki yıl sonra Normandiya çıkarmasını yönetecekti. Savaşın ardından Avrupa’nın ortasına demir perde indi ve dünya iki kampa bölündü.

Türkiye savaşa fiilen girmemişti fakat perdenin tam ucundaydı ve güvenlik kaygısı her şeyin önündeydi. Savaş boyunca tarafsız kalan ülke, barışta kendini yalnız buldu. 1947’de Truman Doktrini’yle Amerikan yardımı geldi, ardından Marshall Planı’nın traktörleri köy yollarına çıktı. Zorlanan Batı kapısını Kore Savaşı açtı. 1950’de Meclise bile danışılmadan Kore’ye gönderilen Türk tugayı, Kunuri’de ve sonrasında ağır kayıplar verdi. Bu bedel Batı’nın Türkiye’ye bakışını değiştirdi. Karara karşı çıkan Barışseverler Cemiyeti üyeleriyse tutuklanıp yargılandı.

Eisenhower o yıllarda yeniden üniforma giymişti. Aralık 1950’de NATO’nun ilk Avrupa başkomutanı oldu ve ittifakın askeri karargahını Paris yakınlarında kurdu. Türkiye 18 Şubat 1952’de onun komutasındaki ittifaka katıldı, Başkomutan Eisenhower üyeliği yerinde mühürlemek için Ankara’ya kadar geldi. Küreyi döndüren el, Türkiye’nin yerini de haritada işaretlemişti.

Eisenhower Ankara’ya ikinci kez 6 Aralık 1959’da, bu kez ABD başkanı olarak geldi. Türkiye’yi görevdeyken ziyaret eden ilk Amerikan başkanıydı. Cumhurbaşkanı Celal Bayar onu Esenboğa’da karşıladı. Eisenhower Anıtkabir’e çelenk bıraktı, ardından Bayar, Başbakan Adnan Menderes ve Dışişleri Bakanı Fatin Rüştü Zorlu ile Çankaya’da görüştü. Ankara Üniversitesi ona fahri doktora verdi, caddeler el sallayan kalabalıklarla doldu. Ertesi sabah Karaçi’ye uçarken Türk halkına olağanüstü karşılama için teşekkür etti.

Ancak ziyaretin ardından yapılan görüşmelerden Türk hükümetinin umduğu büyük ekonomik yardım çıkmadı. Eisenhower’ı uğurlayan liderlerin iktidarı yalnızca beş ay daha sürdü. 27 Mayıs 1960’ta ordu yönetime el koydu, bir yıl sonra Menderes ve Zorlu İmralı’da idam edildi.

Eisenhower ocak 1961’de, görevi devretmeden önce Beyaz Saray’dan Amerikalılara veda konuşmasını yaptı. Normandiya’yı yönetmiş beş yıldızlı general, ülkesini kendi kurduğu makineye karşı uyardı: Devasa ordunun büyük silah sanayisiyle iç içe geçmesi Amerikan tarihinde yeniydi ve oluşan askeri-sanayi kompleksinin haksız nüfuz kazanmasına karşı uyanık olunmalıydı. Yeni gücü dizginleme görevini de uyanık yurttaşlara bıraktı.

Pentagon’daki küre şimdi tamir ediliyor. Kırığı onarılınca yeniden ayağına oturtulacak ve dönebilecek. Ama Antarktika’nın üzerindeki iz, dikkatli bakan gözlerden kaçmayacak.

İttifaklar kuşaklar boyunca, sabırla ve uzmanların eliyle taşınır. Kore’de dökülen kanla, Ankara sokaklarında sallanan ellerle örülür. Eisenhower savaştan sonra bakanlığın adının savaştan savunmaya çevrilmesini desteklemişti, savaşı en iyi bilen general, barışın adını seçmişti. Bugün onun küresini odasına isteyen bakan ise adı yeniden savaş yapmaya çalışıyor.

Pentagon, küre olayını önemsiz olmayan bir haber diye geçiştirdi. Bakan küreyi istedi ama Eisenhower’ın sözlerine hiç kulak vermedi. Türkiyeli biri olarak bu kazayı izlerken aklıma bir soru takılıyor: Ortak tarihin ağırlığını taşıyamayan …

title: Dilovası işçi katliamı davasında 5. duruşma bugün
content:
Dilovası’nda 3'ü çocuk 7 işçinin yaşamını yitirdiği yangına ilişkin davanın beşinci duruşması bugün Kandıra Ceza İnfaz Kurumları Kampüsü’ndeki duruşma salonunda görülecek. 23 sanığın yargılandığı davada 10 sanık tutuklu, 1 sanık ise firari. Aileler, yalnızca imalathanenin patronlarının değil, yıllarca ruhsatsız faaliyete ve denetimsizliğe göz yuman kamu görevlileri ile diğer tüm sorumluların da hesap vermesini istiyor.

Kocaeli’nin Dilovası ilçesinde 8 Kasım 2025’te Ravive Kozmetik’e ait parfüm dolum imalathanesinde çıkan yangında üçü çocuk 7 işçi yaşamını yitirdi. Yangında Hanım Gülek, Esma Gikan, Şengül Yılmaz, Tuncay Yıldız, Tuğba Taşdemir, Nisa Taşdemir ve Cansu Esatoğlu hayatını kaybetti, 6 işçi yaralandı.

Yangının ardından açılan davada ilk duruşma mart ayında görülmüştü. Şirket yetkililerinin yargılandığı dosyaya daha sonra kamu görevlileri hakkında açılan dava da birleştirildi. Böylece sanık sayısı 23’e yükseldi. Eylül ayında görülen dördüncü duruşma itibarıyla 10 sanık tutuklu, 1 sanık firari olarak yargılanıyor.

Davada Ravive Kozmetik yetkilileri İsmail ve Altay Ali Oransal ile ortak üretim yaptığı öne sürülen şirketin yetkilileri Aleyna Oransal ve Gökberk Güngör hakkında “olası kastla öldürme” suçundan ceza isteniyor.

İşyerinin faaliyetinin sürmesine ilişkin denetim ve görevleri bulunan belediye görevlileri hakkında ise “bilinçli taksirle birden fazla kişinin ölümüne neden olma” suçlamasıyla dava açıldı. Böylece davanın önemli başlıklarından birini, yangına ilişkin sorumluluğun yalnızca işyerinin patronlarıyla sınırlı tutulup tutulmayacağı oluşturuyor.

Aileler ise imalathanenin yıllarca faaliyet göstermesinde rolü bulunan kamu kurumlarının ve görevlilerinin sorumluluğunun da ortaya çıkarılmasını istiyor.

Kamu görevlileri hakkındaki dosyanın ana davayla birleşmesiyle birlikte Dilovası Belediyesi’nin denetim sorumluluğu da yargılamanın konusu haline geldi. AKP yönetimindeki Dilovası Belediyesi’nin görevlileri hakkında açılan davada, ruhsatsız çalışan imalathanenin faaliyetinin neden durdurulmadığı ve denetim görevlerinin nasıl yerine getirildiği tartışılıyor.

Ailelerin aktardığı bilgilere göre imalathanenin ruhsatsız çalıştığı yangından kısa süre önce zabıta tarafından tespit edilmişti. Buna karşın işyerinin faaliyetinin sürdüğü, daha önce de farklı kamu kurumlarına şikâyetler yapıldığı belirtildi. Aileler, bu nedenle sorumluluğun yalnızca belediye görevlileriyle de sınırlı tutulmamasını istiyor.

Ailelerin itirazı, yangının yalnızca işyerindeki eksiklikler üzerinden değerlendirilmesine karşı çıkıyor. Ruhsatsız imalathanenin yıllarca çalışmasına izin veren, yapılan şikâyetleri karşılıksız bırakan ve denetim görevini yerine getirmeyen bütün kurum ve kişilerin sorumluluğunun araştırılmasını talep ediyor. Belediye görevlilerinin yanı sıra bakanlıklar, denetim kurumları ve diğer kamu görevlilerinin de yargılama kapsamına alınması gerektiğini vurguyor. Aileler ayrıca imalathaneye iş veren şirketler ile işyerindeki çalışma koşullarından sorumlu olan diğer kişi ve kuruluşların da soruşturulmasını istiyor.

Davanın ilk duruşması mart ayında Kandıra Cezaevi Yerleşkesi’ndeki salonda görüldü. Mahkeme, tutuklu sanıkların durumunu ve dosyadaki delilleri değerlendirdi. Mayıs ayında görülen ikinci duruşmada, daha önce imalathanede çalışmış 17 yaşındaki bir işçi tanık olarak dinlendi. Tanık, 15 yaşında işe başladığını ve sigortasız çalıştırıldığını anlattı. Aynı duruşmada bazı sanıkların tutukluluk durumları ve dosyadaki deliller değerlendirildi.

Temmuz ayında görülen üçüncü duruşmada ise tutuklu sanıkların telefon ve bilgisayarlarındaki dijital materyallerin incelenmesi gündeme geldi. Mahkeme, bazı sanıkların tutukluluklarının devamına karar verdi ve duruşmayı eylül ayına erteledi.

Eylül ayında görülen dördüncü duruşmada ise belediye görevlileri hakkındaki dosyanın ana dosyayla birleşmesinin ardından kamu görevlilerinin sorumluluğu da yargılamada daha geniş biçimde ele alındı. Mahkeme, Dilovası Belediyesi Zabıta Müdür Vekili Nizamettin Balcı ile eski Zabıta Müdür Vekili Cengiz Taşdemir’in yeniden tutuklanmasına, dört belediye görevlisinin ise adli kontrol şartıyla tahliye edilmesine karar verdi.

Bugünkü beşinci duruşma, yangının birinci yılının dolmasına günler kala görülecek. Aileler, davanın imalathanenin patronları ve birkaç belediye görevlisiyle sınırlı kalmamasını; yangının meydana gelmesine uzanan denetimsizlik zincirinde sorumluluğu bulunan herkesin yargılanmasını istiyor.

author: Alyssa Bowen
title: Leonard Leo-Linked VA Bishop Pushes Congregants to Vote for Regressive Agenda
content:
Moves by the Trump administration may be emboldening churches to jump into state proposition fights.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

On November 3, Virginians will vote on two ballot initiatives that have become the center of a well-resourced campaign led by Catholic Bishop Michael Burbidge.

This campaign is urging congregants to vote “no” on two ballot measures. Ballot Question 1 would affirm abortion access as a constitutional right in the Commonwealth of Virginia. Ballot Question 2 would repeal a 2006 same-sex marriage ban that defines marriage as between one man and one woman. Burbidge, who leads Virginia’s Arlington Diocese, which says it has 432,000 registered parishioners, is using his position to call on Catholic parishioners to vote against abortion access and marriage equality for all Virginians and to urge others to do the same.

This campaign has deployed the resources of the church, including church bulletins and guest speakers to preach against the ballot initiatives. The Archdiocese of Arlington itself hosts the CatholicsVoteNo.com website, which states that the church is “not partisan” while condemning the supposed “many evils and unintended consequences” of the initiatives, and even assailing surrogacy.

That website also features a “pledge to vote no,” and details how followers can get involved in opposing the ballot measures, from hosting registration drives to reaching out to their specific pastor for directions on community outreach. Burbidge’s identified goal is to convince the nearly 700,000 confirmed Catholics across the state to vote “no” on these amendments, a figure that could be decisive in making the initiatives fail.

For decades, the IRS forbade places of worship from endorsing or opposing political candidates as tax-exempt organizations. However, Donald Trump’s IRS has recently engaged in efforts to roll back what’s known as the “Johnson Amendment,” a tax provision that has been in place for more than 70 years that bars tax-exempt nonprofits from endorsing or opposing political candidates. That move was struck down in the courts, but it is currently under appeal in the U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. In the meantime, the IRS has issued new guidance on the Johnson Amendment, seemingly giving tax-exempt places of worship enough legal wiggle room to engage in political campaigning directly to parishioners without jeopardizing their status. Beyond that, there is no legal bar on nonprofits engaging on public policy issues, including on referenda, as with the documented role of the Mormon Church in opposing marriage equality via Proposition 8 in California in 2008.

If Virginia is any indication, the Trump administration’s efforts to lift limits on churches directly backing political candidates may be emboldening churches that may have previously stayed out of state proposition fights to jump in strongly, using the hierarchy and wide reach of a religious institution to tell adherents how to vote. For years, Catholic Church leadership in the U.S. has wrestled with controversy and pressure to deny holy communion to believers in public office who vote to protect access to abortion. This includes Burbidge, who used his post to uphold a ban from a San Francisco archbishop denying Speaker Nancy Pelosi communion in the Arlington diocese because of her support as a representative for abortion access and, in 2022, he publicly called on Joe Biden to “repent” for his support of abortion health care.

In this coming election in Virginia, as a leader within the Catholic Church, Bishop Burbidge is using the resources contributed by his congregation to call on parishioners to vote in support of his anti-LGBTQ, anti-abortion agenda. Meanwhile, the majority of Catholics in the U.S. support marriage equality and access to abortion health care.

Burbidge has close ties to Leonard Leo and his more than $1 billion network of groups, which includes the Marble Freedom Trust and Rule of Law Trust. Leo’s network helped capture the U.S. Supreme Court that overturned Roe v. Wade and now is being marshaled to capture other key democratic institutions, from state courts, to the media, to the entertainment industry, to push Leo’s regressive agenda. author: Sharon Zhang
title: Stevens Endorsed Rogers Right After He Touted His Support of Abortion Bans
content:
Mike Rogers once co-sponsored a federal bill that would ban abortions from the point of conception.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Rep. Haley Stevens’s (D-Michigan) surprise endorsement of Republican former Rep. Mike Rogers for Senate over Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday came amid renewed attention on Rogers’s anti-abortion views after he bragged about his stance in an appearance on a conservative radio show last week.

Last Thursday, as the Detroit Metro Times noted, Rogers touted his stances against abortion and trans rights.

“Is it safe to say that we don’t have to worry about you joining Democrats when it comes to things like … supporting gender mutilation surgery for minors, abortion through all nine months of pregnancy for any reason whatsoever?” Dutko said, overexaggerating stances on both issues. “Can we feel confident as evangelical Christians that you’re going to be on our side on some of these social issues?”

“You don’t even have to think about it twice. I’ve been very open about all of those issues — including, for the time I was in Congress, having a 100 percent pro-life rating. I am actually the guy who will stop trangender mutilation of our kids with these trangender surgeries,” Rogers said.

Rogers said the members of his family “are all conservative Christians. This is the only way that I know how to be.”

The clip was posted by Democrats and El-Sayed, who criticized the stance and highlighted Rogers’s history of backing extreme anti-abortion legislation.

“A vote for Mike Rogers is a vote for a national abortion ban,” said El-Sayed in a post on social media.

As Reproductive Freedom for All pointed out on Sunday, Rogers voted for a national abortion ban that would prohibit abortions past 20 weeks as a House member in 2013, and has even cosponsored radically dangerous bills to ban all abortions from the point of conception. Additionally, Rogers said in 2010 that he thinks abortion “should be legal only to prevent the death of the mother” — meaning that he doesn’t support exclusions for rape, incest, or when continuing pregnancy could harm the pregnant person or the fetus.

Rogers’s campaign responded to those posting about the clip by saying that he’s against a national ban. In a post on social media on Saturday, he highlighted a clip in which he said that “Michigan voters have already decided the issue, and I respect that decision” and that he “won’t do anything to change it.”

Abortion rights advocates were skeptical. “Nothing can erase Mike Rogers’ votes or make him any less dangerous to our reproductive freedom,” said Reproductive Freedom for All President and CEO Mini Timmaraju in a statement after Stevens’s announcement on Sunday.

Timmaraju also condemned Stevens for backing Rogers. “Haley Stevens is giving cover to a politician who spent his career trying to ban abortion and was still bragging about that record just days ago,” Timmaraju said.

Stevens has previously touted her support for abortion rights, including during her primary campaign this year. In a speech on the House floor in 2023, she pledged to the women of her state that she would “return to the House of Representatives and seek to enshrine your rights into law” and combat the overturn of Roe v. Wade. “I will not stop until we enshrine women’s rights into the law of this land,” she said.

On the campaign trail for her House seat in 2022, Stevens had suggested that her opponent, incumbent Rep. Andy Levin, was not as committed to abortion rights as she was because he is a man.

On Sunday, however, Levin pointed out that Stevens’s view on abortion was compromised by conservative super PACs that were backing her campaign at the time. Stevens’s ascendancy that year was buoyed by a $5.4 million injection into her campaign by the pro-Israel lobby, including AIPAC, which wanted Levin ousted over his criticism of Israel’s occupation of Palestine.

That year was “the summer of the Dobbs decision, and ultimately voters placed their trust in a ‘pro-choice’ woman who promised to protect their reproductive freedoms,” wrote Levin in a thread on X. “Our campaign pointed out time and again how Democrats should not welcome outsized spending by Super PACS that support anti-choice, MAGA insurrectionists into our primaries, and today we see the logical conclusion of those alliances.”
